jobs.title: Builder - Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

At Reevo, we're reimagining the entire revenue stack from the ground up, and we're doing it with speed. We're building software that orchestrates every go-to-market motion, enabling B2B teams to operate faster, smarter, and more collaboratively. By combining automation, intelligence, and a radically intuitive interface, we're helping companies unlock new levels of productivity and growth across marketing, sales, ops, and customer success teams.



If you're excited about working on a product that reshapes how revenue teams work and being surrounded by curious, driven teammates, you'll feel right at home here. From day one, you'll get real ownership, real mentorship, and real impact. Our team of 50+ builders has 30 exits under their belt, so you'll be in good company, and working alongside the best!




THE OPPORTUNITY:

We’re hiring a Product Marketer Lead to own core product marketing at Reevo. This is a high-ownership, high-influence role for someone who thrives at the intersection of positioning rigor and customer insight.



You will operate as the strategic architect crafting category-defining narratives, driving high-impact go-to-market strategies, and delivering measurable revenue growth. This role offers the opportunity to do the best work of your career, while shaping the future of AI sales technology.



Because of the close collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, this role is required to be in-office (Santa Clara or San Francisco) 5 days a week.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN: 

 - Narrative and positioning development : Define clear, differentiated positioning that turns complex AI-driven features into sharp customer value. You will establish a high bar for clarity, taste, and storytelling, ensuring everyone at Reevo speaks about our products with a unified, compelling voice.

 - End-to-end product marketing strategy: Lead GTM planning from ideation through adoption. You won’t just "launch" products; you’ll create market moments that get noticed, driving both top-of-funnel excitement and bottom-line pipeline.

 - Product Influence & Customer Intelligence: Partner closely with Product teams to influence the roadmap by synthesizing customer conversations, usage data, and competitive intelligence.

 - Revenue and sales enablement: Increase win rates and deal velocity by equipping Sales with world-class assets: pitches, demo narratives, and competitive battlecards. You will bridge the gap between "how it works" and "why it wins" in the room with customers.

 - Growth and web strategy: Own the product storytelling across the website and key growth surfaces. You’ll continuously optimize for conversion and clarity, ensuring a consistent narrative across the entire customer lifecycle.

 - Scalable systems and AI mastery: Build repeatable GTM playbooks that won’t break as the team doubles in size. You will leverage AI tools (including Reevo!) to automate routine tasks and amplify your impact, setting the standard for how a Product Marketer operates today.




WHO YOU ARE:

 - Highly curious: You are fascinated by the sales function and how it works, this curiosity motivates you to help solve the problems no one else has.

 - Obsessed with clarity: You have a proven track record of distilling "noisy" markets into simple, undeniable value propositions.

 - High creative bar: You care about the "craft"—the words on the page, the flow of a deck, and the aesthetic of a launch.

 - Operationally rigorous: You build systems, not just one-offs. You align Product, Marketing, and Sales to ensure everyone is moving toward the same goal.




WHAT YOU BRING:

 - 6+ years in Product Marketing in high-growth AI or modern B2B SaaS environments with a track record of building and scaling processes, preferably in Sales/Revenue startups

 - Experience partnering with product teams on messaging, positioning, and bringing products to market alongside marketing and sales teams

 - Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge thinking, elevate quality and provide clear strategic direction

 - Strong understanding of B2B customer buying processes, sales processes, revenue expansion and the ability to diagnose and optimize a revenue funnel

 - High agency, low ego, and a bias for action. You thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments and push work forward without waiting for perfect clarity

 - A high bar for messaging precision, product storytelling, and visual presentation where details matter.

 - Comfort with data to make decisions, measure impact, iterate quickly, and anchor outcomes.

 - Comfortable and familiar building and automating processes with Notion and AI tools

 - Exceptional writing skills with demonstrated ability to adapt tone, style, and complexity across audiences
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER: 

 - Compensation: A highly competitive base salary and bonus structure, and early-stage equity that aligns your success directly with the company's growth.

 - Comprehensive benefits: health, dental, and vision coverage, generous paid time off (PTO), plus additional benefits that support how you work.

 - Growth and development: Career advancement paths, dedicated mentorship opportunities, and a strong commitment to investing in your continuous professional development and skill enhancement.

 - Dynamic culture: Join a collaborative, innovative, and fast-paced work environment where your direct contributions have a tangible and immediate impact on the product, the sales strategy, and the overall company trajectory.
   
   

Here at Reevo, we know the best ideas come from people with different experiences and perspectives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic, and we’re happy to provide accommodations throughout the application process.

jobs.title: Builder - Product Lead, Find
jobs.description:
ABOUT REEVO:

Reevo is a fast-growing startup at the forefront of AI-driven sales and revenue operations. Our mission is to simplify complex processes for mid-market and SMBs, enabling them to scale efficiently through intelligent, integrated platforms.

The global sales platforms software market is projected to grow from $73.3 billion in 2025 to $221.6 billion by 2035, representing an 11.7% CAGR. AI, automation, and predictive analytics are identified as key growth drivers.

However, sales orgs have bloated tech stacks ranging from 10 (sales org of ~25 people) to 20+ (sales org of ~250 people) different point solutions. Companies are looking to significantly simplify their tech stack and have it work for them instead of the other way around. Every sales tool claims to create an all-in-one revenue platform, but nobody is fulfilling that promise.



This tech stack is costly and hinders sales productivity:

 - Productivity lost: when reps update CRM, it takes 2-4 hours / week through the help of UX tools

 - Revenue lost: CRM data is "garbage in, garbage out" and CRM's data visualization / drill-down capabilities are very poor. Visibility into what's working and what's not is very low. This means no predictive or real-time insights to guide executives in decision-making.

 - Software cost: adding tools that marginally help sales team productivity

 - Headcount cost: hiring Sales / Revenue Ops teams just to wrangle the tech stack and surface insights

Reevo's vision: revolutionize sales by delivering revenue in a box:

 - All activities happen in an AI-native operating platform with features that help teams sell

 - Unified data layer that's context-rich

 - Form insights for coaching sales teams and making better strategic decisions
   
   


THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Product Lead to own the Find pillar, which is Reevo's prospecting and pipeline creation surface. You will define how modern GTM teams decide who to sell.

Prospecting today is fragmented across data vendors, intent tools, enrichment platforms, and spreadsheets. Find collapses that stack into one surface, with sellers searching for companies and people that match their ICP, surface buying signals, and seamlessly convert prospects directly into CRM objects, workflows, and outreach.



This role will own:

 - Prospecting data infrastructure (company and people data, enrichment waterfalls, coverage and match quality)

 - Intent and signal systems (funding, hiring, technographic, web, and product signals that tell teams who to pursue and when)

 - ICP and lookalike definition (turning a customer's best accounts into a repeatable definition of the next thousand)

 - AI-assisted research and list building (agentic account research that replaces hours of manual digging)

 - People and company search and discovery UX for go-to-market teams
   
   


WHO YOU ARE:

 - Data-minded product thinker. You love problems where data quality, ranking, and UX all matter at once, and you know how to hold all three without losing the thread.

 - Prospecting domain experience. You've worked on prospecting platforms, sales intelligence, data enrichment, intent products, search/discovery surfaces, or data-heavy B2B products.

 - Fluent in data fundamentals. You understand entity resolution, data provider economics, match rates, signal freshness, and what separates usable intent data from noise.

 - Opinionated about discovery UX. You know how to make a seller trust a list they didn't build by hand, how to surface "why this account, why now," and how to keep precision high enough that the surface earns daily usage.

 - Sharp in ambiguity. You can turn a broad problem ("help customers find pipeline") into a clear roadmap with real prioritization instincts.

 - Technically fluent. You can reason about data pipelines, vendor APIs, and scoring models, and you're comfortable partnering closely with engineering and AI teams on architecture decisions.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Drive the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for Find from data foundations to the discovery experience

 - Build and manage the enrichment layer: provider selection, waterfall logic, match quality, coverage benchmarks, and cost-per-record economics

 - Define the intent and signal architecture: which signals matter per segment, how they're scored, and how they trigger downstream action

 - Ship ICP modeling and lookalike discovery that turns a customer's closed-won history into a ranked universe of next-best accounts

 - Launch AI-assisted account research and list building that compresses hours of manual prospecting into minutes

 - Connect Find to the rest of Reevo: discovered accounts become CRM records, signals trigger workflows, lists feed outreach

 - Navigate data licensing, redistribution, and compliance constraints (GDPR, CCPA, provider ToS) as first-class product requirements

 - Drive adoption and prove pipeline impact: accounts discovered, signals acted on, pipeline created from Find
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 6+ years of product management experience in B2B software

 - Experience driving data-intensive products (sales intelligence, enrichment, intent, search, or data platforms)

 - Strong technical fluency: comfortable discussing data pipelines, entity resolution, vendor APIs, and scoring tradeoffs

 - Proven ability to ship multi-surface platform features end-to-end

 - Deep customer empathy for both reps who live in the product daily and ops leaders who own data quality

 - High ownership, strong prioritization instincts, and comfort operating in ambiguity

If you want to drive the front door of the revenue funnel shaping who every GTM team sells to next - this is your role.




WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Compensation: A highly competitive base salary and transparent commission structure, and early-stage equity that aligns your success directly with the company's growth.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, generous paid time off (PTO), and other valuable perks designed to support your well being.

 - Growth & Development: Clearly defined career advancement paths, dedicated mentorship opportunities, and a strong commitment to investing in your continuous professional development and skill enhancement.
